item.title: OnAir Pro 4.46-beta.1
item.description:
What's New in OnAir Pro 4.46-beta.1

  • Fixed false "Record this meeting?" prompt appearing at the end of meetings (stale device poll during state transitions).
  • Safari (and other browsers) no longer get woken up in the dock when OnAir scans for meeting platforms — only the frontmost browser is now scanned.
  • Added automatic retry on transient Anthropic API errors (HTTP 529/503/502/504) with exponential backoff, so summaries no longer fail when the API is briefly overloaded.
  • Back-to-back meetings: a new recording can now start while the previous meeting's summary is still being generated. Both summaries are correctly attributed to their own session.
  • Fixed potential data integrity issue where a long summary finishing after a new meeting started could be saved against the wrong session.

item.title: OnAir Pro 4.45
item.description:
What's New in OnAir Pro 4.45

  • ConfigManager: migrate auto for missing/legacy keys
  • Add documentation header + alphabetical sorting
  • Centralize file rendering via renderConfigFile
  • Add min_recording_seconds to defaults
  • Remove shortcut_name (legacy)
  • Meeting recap ready now uses OnAir notifications.
  • Adjsuted menu items so Start recording is available when manually turned on.
  • Reviewed configuration window layout.
  • Fixing reload configuration during an ongoing meeting.
  • Added summary verbosity setting (short, long).
  • Reviewed and optimized Configuration Screen.
  • Added polling after meeting to prevend physical device state to trigger a meeting detection.

item.title: OnAir Pro 4.35
item.description:
What's New in OnAir Pro 4.35

  • Redesigned the first-launch setup experience.
  • OnAir now works without a physical device.
  • Improved device code validation.
  • Improved configuration screen to not interrupt recording when saving.
  • Adjusted prompt for better results.
  • Added documentation for cfg file.
